title: Quick-Return Pricing for Small Business Electricity Supply Renewals After Rollover
content:
**Quick-return adjustment.** For a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement renewed inside the grace period after rollover, the calendar days from the rollover date to the handling date are counted; 5 days or fewer take 0.06 cents per kWh off the grace-period renewal rate; 6 to 10 days take 0.03 cents off; more than 10 days take nothing off.

The rollover date is the plan change date recorded on the agreement when it rolled over; the count is the difference in calendar days between that date and the handling date.

| Calendar days from rollover to the handling date | Quick-return adjustment |
|---|---|
| 5 or fewer | 0.06 cents per kWh off |
| 6 to 10 | 0.03 cents per kWh off |
| more than 10 | nothing off |

**Boundaries (hypothetical rollover date 1 January)**

| Handling date | Days | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 6 January | 5 | 0.06 cents off |
| 7 January | 6 | 0.03 cents off |
| 11 January | 10 | 0.03 cents off |
| 12 January | 11 | nothing off |
